description: Turn auto-reload on or off, or change it: when credits drop below `threshold`, the saved card buys `pack` again, up to `monthly_max_usd` per month. Needs CONTEXTFETCH_API_KEY and a card saved at checkout. The monthly cap cannot be raised above $500 here.

enabled.description: true to turn auto-reload on, false to turn it off.

monthly_max_usd.description: Monthly spending cap in USD (at most 500).

pack.description: Pack to buy: instant $15/15,000, builder $50/60,000, scale $150/200,000.

threshold.description: Reload when credits drop below this (100-100,000, default 1,000).

name: contextfetch_auto_reload
title: ContextFetch auto-reload
